D: A slacker owing money for a car crash takes a job at Good Burger, where cashier Ed's secret sauce takes on the giant Mondo Burger across the street.
P: Serve the burgers when Dexter finds the sauce Ed made for his lunch.
S: Ed's sauce makes Otis glad he's not dead.

Bake the fries on two trays at 220C, turning once, until deep gold and crisp. Start the sauce with a squeeze of lemon juice and the tomato sauce, then whisk in the mayo, relish, mustard, paprika and garlic powder. Salt the hot fries and serve with a big bowl of sauce.
A meat patty is something, says Ed.

Roll the mince into 8 balls and season well. Smash each ball flat on a very hot griddle and cook 2 minutes until crusty, then flip and top with cheese. Toast the buns on the griddle. Build with sauce, mustard, onion, pickles and the patties and serve hot.
M: The Good Burger with Ed's sauce
Ed's secret sauce saves Good Burger.

Mix a squeeze of lemon with the tomato sauce, mayo and relish to make the sauce. Shape the mince into 8 thin patties and season well. Cook on a very hot griddle 2 minutes a side, laying cheese on each after the flip. Toast the buns cut side down. Stack two patties per bun with lettuce, tomato, onion and lots of sauce.
Garlic and parmesan meatballs in a sub roll. Mess with Kurt, into the grinder.

Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic and salt and roll into 16 balls. Brown the meatballs in a hot oiled pan, then add the passata, oregano and remaining garlic and simmer. Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce and lay the provolone on top. Grill until the cheese melts and bubbles, then finish with basil.
W: Ice cream truck getaway choc tops
Ed pelts a truck with ice cream.

Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil gently and cool to room temperature. Scoop the ice cream firmly into the cones, pressing a ball on top, and freeze for 10 minutes. Dip each top in the chocolate, scatter with sprinkles and stand upright in a glass until set.
K: Grape Nose Boy grape soda spider
Ed turns into Grape Nose Boy at lunch.
Drop two scoops of ice cream into each of 4 tall chilled glasses. Pour the soda slowly down the side so it foams up. Top with a few grape halves and serve with a long spoon and straw.
